components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1

## Summary

I added an optional `email` field to pet owners, validated and stored/returned lower-cased, per the specification.

**Changes made:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema (not in `required`), with `format: email`, `maxLength: 255`, and `x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"`. The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` thus carries `@Email`, so the controller's `@Valid` binding rejects a present-but-invalid address with **400** (confirmed in the logs for `not-an-email`), while a missing email passes.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`, `@Email`) with getter/setter.

3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a `normalizeEmail` qualifier (null-safe `trim().toLowerCase()`) wired into `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`, mirroring the existing telephone normalization. The entity stores the canonical lower-cased value, so `toOwnerDto` returns it lower-cased (`Test.User@Example.COM` → `test.user@example.com`).

4. **DB schemas** — Added the `email` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`). The test profile uses `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema change was required.

5. **Seed data** — The positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)` statements in `hsqldb/data.sql` and `mysql/data.sql` would break with the new column, so I gave them explicit column lists (postgres/h2 already listed columns). The seed `email` defaults to NULL.

**Result:** `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — covering lower-casing, invalid-email rejection (400), and missing-email acceptance.
